title: Reincarnation Isn’t Enough to Fill the Hole in My Heart
description:
In another world, a person's deepest desires manifest as their own unique magic.
Adepts, the transcendents who wield this magic to protect humanity from evil gods, are granted absolute privileges.

Having suffered from profound loneliness in his past life, Konoe strongly desires to be someone's number one.
After a long period of training, he finally earns the title of Adept— Doing all of this just so he can use a forbidden love potion.

However, the person who comes to him seeking help is a golden-haired girl afflicted by a fatal illness...
author: Niteron
